BiblicalUsage: Êqer — Eker — was an Israelite of the tribe of Judah, a son of Ram. He appears once, in the genealogy of Judah in Chronicles. His fuller story is on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eker matters because the genealogy matters: God kept the record of Judah's sons, and He kept Eker's name in it.
